🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 4, 2026

Moon, in Virgo, holds a sextile to Mercury, in Scorpio. Two ways of valuing a thing, meeting at one point: what you already own finally finds the words to be counted.

Easier — Agreeing on a figure without feeling robbed by it.
Harder — Agreeing to something because agreeing feels pleasant.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a 2-week sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Venus opposes you from Libra, and the account has two columns. Fire that starts things, billed for starting. The hold Mercury had a week ago is not there any more.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. From Virgo, Moon makes it easy, which is not the same as right. Earth keeps what it has, cheaply. Four weeks ago Venus was still in Scorpio: the ground has moved.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you and passes through Scorpio as a guest. From Virgo, Moon cuts across the appetite. Mutable air keeps two accounts open and pays both. Mars let go of it a week ago.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, crosses Virgo untitled. Mercury trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Water moves first here, and first is enough. The sextile to Saturn that held a week ago has let go.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, untitled in Scorpio. From Scorpio, Mercury sets a figure against the wanting. Fire keeps its grip past the point it is worth. Sun left Libra four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, is only passing through Scorpio. Moon crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Earth shifts until the two options are one. Retrograde since two weeks ago, Mercury is still re-reading.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is at home in Libra. From Leo, Mars makes something possible and nothing certain. Cardinal air: the opening move is the cheap one. The conjunction of a week ago is off it now.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. From Virgo, Moon hands you an opening. Fixed water keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. This was not here last week, and has no history yet.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon squares you from Virgo, and something has to give way. Fire bends, and each bend is invoiced. A week ago Jupiter was still held by Mercury; that is finished.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Moon in Virgo sides with you before you have argued. Cardinal earth: beginning costs almost nothing. Two weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. Mercury in Scorpio stands at a right angle: friction, and a clear number. Air that holds on, charged for holding. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon in Virgo sits opposite: your figure meets somebody else’s. Water that changes shape, charged for each shape. A week ago this angle was not there. It is now.
